# Copilot instructions for PawReminder

## Documentation discipline

Always keep the project documentation aligned with the actual state of the codebase.

When a change adds a feature, fixes a bug, improves validation, or completes a milestone:

1. Update [README.md](../README.md) to reflect the current state.
2. Mark the relevant task as completed in the checklist.
3. Add a short validation note describing what was verified.
4. Leave the next pending step clearly stated in the “Estado actual del proceso” section.
5. Keep the documentation factual and based on the code that exists, not on intended future work.

## Required pattern for progress updates

Use this format whenever work is completed:

- [x] Nombre de la tarea completada
- [x] Validado: breve nota de verificación (pruebas, flujo real o revisión de código)
- [ ] Siguiente paso pendiente: descripción del siguiente bloque de trabajo

## General rule

Do not leave the README outdated after implementation work. If the repository changes, the documentation should reflect that immediately.
